items.title: 「エーアイ」をバズワードにしないために RPA 導入経験と Kiro 上での Claude モデル利用経験から
Who Babysits The Agent at 3 a.m.? Automation Using Google AX
items.summary: Handing a Jira ticket to an AI agent takes a minute. Keeping it alive for three hours is the hard part: it waits for a Slack reply, crashes halfway, or loops until the bill gets interesting. We look at three jobs teams already want agents for: turning tickets into pull requests, reviewing PRs, and fixing the alert that pages SRE at 3 a.m. Then we show how Google AX, Google's new open-source runtime for long-running agents, handles them on GKE with Workload Identity, LiteLLM, ArgoCD and HolmesGPT.
